Hi, quick one: how much would Team cost for 6 people?

Team is 8 EUR per seat per month, so for 6 people that is 6 x 8 = 48 EUR per month. If you pay yearly you get 2 months free, so it is 6 x 8 x 10 = 480 EUR for the year instead of 576. Want me to walk you through what Team includes?
no I know whats in it. is the 48 with or without tax?

Those prices are before VAT. If you are in the EU and have a valid VAT id on the account, no VAT is added and you pay exactly 48 EUR. Without a VAT id we add your country's VAT rate on top, for example at 20% that would be 48 x 1.20 = 57.60 EUR. Outside the EU there is no VAT.
great thanks
Happy to help. Whenever you are ready, you can switch to Team from the workspace settings and the seats are counted from the members you add.
What's the actual difference between Team and Business? The pricing page is a bit vague

Sure. Both give you unlimited projects and integrations. Team is 8 EUR per seat per month and keeps 30 days of history. Business is 16 EUR per seat per month and adds SSO, guest access, unlimited history and priority support. So the question is really whether you need single sign-on, guests or history older than 30 days.
we'd probably want SSO at some point but not yet. can we start on team and move up later?

Yes, you can upgrade any time from the workspace settings. The price difference is 8 EUR per seat per month, so for example with 10 people you would go from 10 x 8 = 80 EUR to 10 x 16 = 160 EUR per month. Nothing is lost when you upgrade, your projects and members carry over as they are.
perfect, that's all I needed
Glad it helped. Come back any time when you are ready for SSO.
how does the yearly discount work exactly? the site says 2 months free

It means you pay for 10 months and get 12. On Team that is 8 x 10 = 80 EUR per seat per year instead of 8 x 12 = 96 EUR. On Business it is 16 x 10 = 160 EUR per seat per year instead of 192. The whole year is charged up front on the day you switch.
and if we add someone halfway through the year?

Then the new seat is prorated: you are charged only for the days left until your renewal date, at the yearly rate. Roughly, a Team seat added with 6 months left costs about half of 80 EUR, so about 40 EUR, and from the next renewal it is billed as a full seat with the rest.
ok makes sense, ta
You're welcome. If you tell me your team size I can put the exact yearly total together for you.
We're thinking about going back to Free for a while. what happens to our stuff?

Nothing is deleted when you downgrade, but Free has limits: up to 3 members, 1 project and no integrations. Before the switch you would need to get the workspace down to 3 members and 1 active project, and any connected integrations stop syncing. Your tasks stay in the workspace.
we have 5 people and 4 projects right now, thats a lot to cut

It is. The alternative is staying on Team at 8 EUR per seat, which for 5 people is 5 x 8 = 40 EUR per month, or 5 x 80 = 400 EUR per year with the yearly discount. If you only need 3 people for a while, Team for 3 is 3 x 8 = 24 EUR per month and keeps all 4 projects and the integrations.
ok, I'll talk to the others. thanks
Sure. If you do decide to downgrade, cancelling Team stops the next renewal and you keep the paid features until the end of the current period.
Can I put 3 of my people on Business and the rest on Team? Only the managers need SSO.
Not at the moment, sorry: a workspace is on one plan and every seat in it is billed at that rate. So if the managers need SSO, the whole workspace moves to Business at 16 EUR per seat per month.
thats annoying. we're 12 in total

On the yearly plan with 2 months free, Business would be 12 x 160 = 1920 EUR per year, Team 12 x 80 = 960 EUR. If SSO is mainly a convenience, some teams stay on Team and use passwords with 2FA.
ok thanks, I'll think about it
Sounds good. If you go for Business, the upgrade applies to the whole workspace right away and your projects stay exactly as they are.
do guests count as seats? we have external clients who need to see one project each

Guests do not take a seat, but guest access is a Business feature. On Business you pay 16 EUR per seat per month for your own members, and guests you invite to individual projects are not billed. On Team there are no guests: anyone you add becomes a full member and counts as a seat at 8 EUR.
so for 4 of us plus like 10 clients?

On Business: 4 x 16 = 64 EUR per month, and the 10 client guests are free. On Team you would need to add the clients as members: 14 x 8 = 112 EUR per month. So with that many external people Business is actually the cheaper option.

It surprises a lot of people. And yearly Business for 4 seats would be 4 x 160 = 640 EUR, if you prefer to pay once a year.
I need to add a new hire tomorrow but our billing date is in like 10 days. do I pay a full month for her?

No, seats are prorated. You pay only for the days left in your current cycle, and from the next invoice she is a normal full seat. On Team that means 8 EUR x 10/30, so roughly 2.67 EUR for those 10 days. On Business it is 16 x 10/30, about 5.33 EUR.
and that gets charged straight away or on the next invoice?

The prorated amount is charged for the remaining days when you add the seat, and the next invoice then simply includes her as a full seat. If you ever remove a seat mid-cycle it works the other way round: the unused days are credited on your next invoice.
